summary: Ecopetrol S.A. filed a Form 6-K announcing administrative measures to ensure proper shareholder representation at an Extraordinary Shareholders Meeting scheduled for September 15, 2026. The measures include proxy requirements, prohibitions on management influencing proxies or voting, and designation of corporate areas to verify powers of attorney. This is a routine corporate governance notice, not a special situation event. The filing contains no strategic transactions or deal terms. It is a procedural communication aligned with Colombian regulatory requirements.
